reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in your DM to say I've noted the change: from now on, his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Tamarack rollout is Thursdays at 9:30.

I didn't touch his calendar, since he said no action was needed. The note stays in this DM and won't be passed to anyone else.

I told him I don't have a separate place to store reminders, so this DM message is the only record. I also offered to add the call to his calendar as a recurring event if he wants that.
